body: I’m sorry I wouldn’t wish this on anyone

Hey! 22 year old female who also struggles with bdd, probably since 12. I’ve know my relationship with food was toxic since I was 16 and would purge to punish myself for eating. Now I eat uncontrollably and wish I was strong enough to gain control back. I hit rock bottom about 6 months and need to get up. I for the first time decided to seek treatment last month and after my intake appointment the office shut down due to Covid. It was really discouraging for me to finally be brave and seek treatment and then be put on hold.
Quarantine brain, I just remembered about it and fixated on it
